title: ddong-meong
context: A humorous interactive wellness app and connected exhibition screen.
summary: A 4-minute-33-second meditation experience for time spent on the toilet.
paragraphs: The mobile app borrows the exceptionally calm and courteous language of wellness services. Its exhibition screen turns private sessions into a shared field of nicknames, times and activity. The relationship between those two experiences exposes the contradiction of using another platform to escape platform-shaped attention.
